The Club

About the Club

The Club, its facilities, activities and opportunities to play.

On this page
Club eveningsBeginners' eveningsMembershipFixturesThe Varsity MatchStudent ChampionshipsClub documents

The Club promotes association croquet within the University at every level. You can come for a social game, learn from other members, or compete at a high level.

Members have access to two full-size courts in the University Parks, together with Club equipment and coaching. A hut key can be provided against a deposit, and you only need flat-soled shoes to play.

The Club welcomes complete beginners as well as experienced players. We run coaching sessions, Club evenings and fixtures for a range of standards. Handicap play also allows players of different strengths to have competitive games together.

Club evenings

Wednesday evenings are Club evenings, with members and committee members usually at the courts from 5 p.m. onwards. The arrangement continues through the summer vacation.

Beginners' evenings

At the start of Trinity term, the Club runs free coaching sessions for beginners and non-members. Committee members and experienced players are available to help new players learn the basics and get comfortable on court.

Membership

Membership is open to University and non-University players, subject to the Club's current arrangements and any University limits. See the membership page for current options, access arrangements and joining instructions.

Fixtures

The Club's fixtures range from beginner-friendly matches to higher-level competition. Members are encouraged to enter fixtures at a level appropriate to their experience. Contact the Captain if you would like to play.

The Varsity Match

OUACC plays Cambridge University at the Hurlingham Club in London. The match combines singles and doubles and forms one of the Club's principal annual fixtures.

Croquet is a Half Blue sport at Oxford. The Club can recommend players for University sporting awards in line with the University's current criteria. See the Half Blues page for the historic list.

Student Championships

The Student Championships are open to full-time students and include singles and doubles competition. See the Student Championships page for current information.

Club documents

The Club documents page brings together the Constitution, Code of Conduct, Complaints Procedure and Safety Policy.
